components.css: .ds-legend { width: 240px; padding: 24px; background: #000; border-left: 1px solid #262c30; border-right: 1px solid #262c30; font-family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-family: 'Archivo Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 125%; font-weight: 650; font-size: 11.5px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #9fa29a; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-legend a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 6px 10px; margin-left: -10px; border-radius: 5px; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.4; color: #c6c8c0; text-decoration: none; transition: color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), background-color 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-legend a:hover, .ds-legend a[aria-current='page'] { color: #f3f0e7; background: #13171a; } .ds-legend a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f0954f; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-legend .ds-mark { color: #9fa29a; } .ds-legend a:hover .ds-mark { color: #c6c8c0; } .ds-mark { display: inline-block; flex: none; width: 9px; height: 9px; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; } .ds-mark[data-level='full'] { background: currentColor; } .ds-mark[data-level='partial'] { background: linear-gradient(135deg, currentColor 50%, transparent 50%); }

narrative.overview:
The site is a map of the API, drawn the way a Minecraft filled map is drawn: a true-black ground ruled into 16px chunks, a near-black reading sheet laid over it, and a legend that tells you where you are and what holds on your server. Every page is the same three-part chart, centred as one composition: the legend rail on the left, the reading sheet in the middle, the margin on the right carrying the ownership map, the support legend and the on-this-page list.

Meaning is carried by marks before colour. A filled square is supported or done, a half square is partial or in progress, a hollow square is none or planned, a dash is not applicable. Colour is rationed by role: terracotta says "you are here", teal and violet say "region" and "global", and nothing else is coloured. Density is that of a working reference read beside an IDE: tabular mono numerals, hairline rules, compact legend rows, a 70ch reading measure.

The system rejects the Starlight and PaperMC docs silhouette (stock header, filled-pill sidebar, coloured callout boxes, centred hero over icon cards) and recoloured template sites; the owner confirmed both.
keyCharacteristics: OLED true-black ground with a low-contrast chunk grid in the frame only, never under reading text.
One centred three-column chart: rail, sheet, margin.
Support and status shown as square marks first; colour follows the mark.
Wide, tight Archivo for display; Atkinson Hyperlegible Next for reading; JetBrains Mono for code and every number.
Flat surfaces stepped by tone and hairline rules; no glow.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Terracotta means "you are here", teal means a region, violet means the global region. A hue never carries a second meaning, and nothing else on the page is coloured.

rules.name: The Mark Before Colour Rule
rules.body: Every state is legible in greyscale: the square's fill shape carries the meaning, colour only follows it.

rules.name: The Grid Stays In The Frame Rule
rules.body: The chunk grid shows on the ground (rail, margin, gutters) and never under the reading sheet, code or cards.

rules.name: The Numbers Are Coordinates Rule
rules.body: Every version, count and module identifier is set in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, inline in the sentence.

rules.name: The Legend Label Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked Label type heads a group of legend rows or a margin section. It never sits above a page title or a prose heading.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing emits light: no coloured shadows, no blurred halos, no gradients on surfaces. A surface rises by one tone step and a hairline.

dos: Do keep the ground true black (#000000) and set reading on the Reading Sheet, one tone above it.
Do show every support, status or stability state as a filled, half, hollow or dash square before adding any colour.
Do reserve terracotta for "you are here": the current page, the chosen platform, the player's position, keyboard focus.
Do set every version, count and module name in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and one tone step, and open every H2 with a hairline rule.
Do keep rail, sheet and margin as one centred chart, collapsing the margin under the sheet below 1240px.
Do draw icons as inline line SVG at a 1.4px stroke in the current text colour.
donts: Don't reproduce the Starlight or PaperMC docs silhouette: stock header, filled-pill sidebar, coloured callout boxes, a centred hero over icon cards.
Don't colour an aside by type; only danger takes a coloured edge.
Don't give teal, violet or terracotta a second meaning, or introduce a fourth signal hue.
Don't add glow, coloured shadows or surface gradients; the search dialog's dark lift is the only shadow.
Don't run the chunk grid under reading text, code or cards.
Don't put uppercase tracked labels above a page title or prose heading as an eyebrow.
Don't use Mojang's textures, logo or font anywhere in the identity.
